note: What a reply said in a scene about a member's vote leaves: one caused by a veto-override record, between the bill's sponsor and a member who voted no or stayed out (docs/design/scenes/from-life/veto-override-whip.md), is read at the member's next position on the sponsor's bills; one caused by the record of an ask the evening before a floor vote, between the member who asked and the member asked (docs/design/scenes/from-life/the-vote-that-switched.md), is read at the asked member's position on that bill. A reply whose move is in favor counts toward the side asked for as a deal of kind favor (dealWeight in campaigns/parameters.json); one in strain counts the same weight against. Any other move (a stall, a question) leaves nothing. The moves are the purpose arcs' reply moves (src/director/data/purpose-arcs.json).
